business_insights: Churn is imbalanced: 26.5% of customers leave, so recall matters more than raw accuracy.
Month-to-month customers churn the most at 42.7%, making contract type a strong retention signal.
Fiber optic customers show the highest churn among internet segments at 41.9%, suggesting service experience or price sensitivity.
Customers in the first tenure bucket (0-12 months) churn at 48.3%, so early-life retention offers are likely to pay off.
The highest-risk payment method is Electronic check at 45.3% churn, which can help target billing-related interventions.
